name: Duke Xian of Jin
role: Ruler of the state of Jin from 676 to 651 BC
contribution: A ruler of the Jin state, reigning for 26 years.
legacy: During his reign, the Jin state became one of the most powerful and largest states due to his conquests of many small neighboring states

checks.lead: Duke Xian of Jin (Chinese: 晉獻公; pinyin: Jìn Xiàn Gōng), personal name Ji Guizhu, was a ruler of the Jin state, reigning for 26 years. He moved the capital from Quwo (曲沃) to Jiang (絳). He was named after the Rongdi (戎狄) leader Guizhu (詭諸), whom his father and predecessor, Duke Wu, captured alive.
